paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan, son of Yehoshua, son of Rabbi Akiva’s father-in-law.
Mentioned in Mishnah Yadayim, chapter 3, mishnah 5, agreeing with Ben Azzai’s statement.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ג מ״ה explicitly gives Mishnah Yadayim chapter 3 mishnah 5. The named public source at that exact mishnah supplies רבי for both Yochanan and Akiva and the full Yochanan → Yehoshua → Akiva’s father-in-law chain. Both Rabbi titles are retained on that occurrence evidence. Ben Azzai’s statement is the understood object, without adding an otherwise absent name or title. No name or identity of Akiva’s father-in-law is inferred. The digital witness is not a fresh printed-page collation.
